post.description:
Provisions a managed Kubernetes cluster. The cluster is created with a single master node (sized by `sku_id` from Master Plan) and one or more worker **node pools** (`node_pools`, 1-10 pools). Each node pool runs identical worker nodes from the selected worker plan and can define elastic (metric based) and/or scheduled (cron based) autoscaling via `elasticity_dict` and `scheduled_dict`.

The cluster must be attached to a VPC (`vpc_id`, which must be in the `Running` state), and can optionally attach a security group and enable disk encryption. On success the cluster is returned in a `Creating` state - poll List or Detail until it reaches `Running`.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the project to scope the request to. Required integer project ID.
x-constraints: must be a valid integer project ID

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: API key used to authenticate the create request.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Region in which the cluster will be provisioned.
x-constraints: must be a valid region name (e.g., Delhi, Chennai)

schema.description: Create payload for a Kubernetes cluster. Send the master node sizing (`sku_id`, `version`, `slug_name`), the VPC to attach (`vpc_id`), and one or more worker `node_pools` (1-10). For each node pool, send `elasticity_dict` for metric-based scaling, `scheduled_dict` for cron-based scaling, or both - and set `policy_type` accordingly.

version.description: Kubernetes version for the cluster. Must be a version supported by the selected master image (`slug_name`).
x-constraints: must be a supported Kubernetes version (e.g., "1.32")

slug_name.description: Master plan slug (the `plan` string from Master Plan). The region must support managed Kubernetes.
x-constraints: must be a valid master plan slug

vpc_id.description: ID of the VPC network to attach the cluster to.
x-constraints: must reference a VPC in the Running state in the same project and region

subnet_id.description: ID of the subnet within the VPC to place the cluster in.
x-constraints: when set, must be a Running subnet of the selected VPC

sku_id.description: SKU ID of the master node plan (a `specs.id` from Master Plan).
x-constraints: must be a valid master (K8s_Master) SKU ID

security_group_id.description: ID of a security group to attach to the cluster nodes at create time.
x-constraints: must be a valid security group ID in the same project and region

isEncryptionEnabled.description: Whether to enable disk encryption on the cluster nodes.

encryption_passphrase.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the disks. Required when `isEncryptionEnabled` is true.

node_pools.description: Worker node pools to create with the cluster.

name.description: Display name of the node pool.

slug_name.description: Worker plan slug (the `plan` string from Worker Plan).
x-constraints: must be a valid worker plan slug

sku_id.description: SKU ID of the worker plan (a `specs.id` from Worker Plan).
x-constraints: must be a valid worker SKU ID

specs_name.description: Human-readable plan/spec name for the worker nodes.

policy_type.description: Scaling policy mode for the pool. Required when `elasticity_dict` or `scheduled_dict` is supplied.
x-constraints: one of: Default, Custom, Default-Scheduled, Custom-Scheduled, No-policy
required when elasticity_dict or scheduled_dict is set

elasticity_dict.description: Elastic (metric-based) autoscaling configuration, keyed by role (`worker`).

x-constraints: must be between min_vms and max_vms

max_vms.description: Maximum number of worker nodes the pool may scale to.

elasticity_policies.description: Elastic scaling rules, sent as two objects - a scale-up rule (`adjust: 1`) and a scale-down rule (`adjust: -1`).

type.description: Policy type; use "CHANGE" for a relative adjustment.

adjust.description: Number of nodes to add (positive) or remove (negative) when the rule fires.

operator.description: Comparison operator applied to the metric.

value.description: Threshold percentage the metric is compared against.

period_number.description: Number of consecutive evaluation periods the condition must hold before the rule fires.

period.description: Duration of one evaluation period, in seconds.

cooldown.description: Cooldown after scaling, in seconds, before the rule can fire again.

scheduled_dict.description: Scheduled (cron-based) autoscaling configuration, keyed by role (`worker`).

scheduled_policies.description: Scheduled scaling rules that set the node count on a cron schedule.

type.description: Use "CARDINALITY" to set an absolute target node count.

adjust.description: Target number of worker nodes when the schedule fires.

recurrence.description: Cron expression for when the rule fires. Must be a valid cron.
x-constraints: must be a valid cron expression

schema.description: On success the cluster is created in a `Creating` state.
